doubletapfly.help.feature.flight.title: Double Tap Flight
doubletapfly.help.feature.flight.summary: double-tap space to fly like creative mode, tap again or land to stop
doubletapfly.help.feature.flight.detail:
How to use:
1. Double-tap space to take off, double-tap again or touch the ground to stop
2. !doubletapfly switches the whole feature (green = on, red = off)
3. !config FlySpeed = 2 changes the speed, 1 = vanilla creative speed
4. Rebind the toggle in Options -> Controls
Options: Flight / FlySpeed / DoubleTapWindow / FallProtection
Requires: allow-flight=true on the server, otherwise 4 seconds of hovering kicks you
doubletapfly.help.feature.fastplace.summ: drops the vanilla 4 tick cooldown between placements
doubletapfly.help.feature.fastplace.deta:
How to use:
1. It is on by default: just hold right click and place away
2. !fastplace switches it (green = on, red = off)
3. !config PlaceDelay = 1 changes the delay, vanilla is 4, 1 means every tick
4. !config PlacePerTick = 4 also fills the blocks around the one you aim at
Options: FastPlace / PlaceDelay / PlacePerTick
With a schematic: the projection tells you where, this makes it fast
doubletapfly.help.feature.airplace.title: Air Place
doubletapfly.help.feature.airplace.summa: place blocks in mid air, marked with a red box
doubletapfly.help.feature.airplace.detai:
How to use:
1. Run !airplace first - it is off by default, wait for the green line
2. Hold a block item (spawn eggs, armour stands and fireworks work too)
3. Aim at nothing, so the crosshair is not pointing at a block
4. A red box appears at the far end of your reach - that is the target
5. Hold right click and the block lands there
Options: AirPlace / AirPlaceRender
No red box? Check the switch, the held item, and whether you are really aiming at air
doubletapfly.help.feature.fastuse.title: Fast Use
doubletapfly.help.feature.fastuse.summar: eat, drink and throw items faster
doubletapfly.help.feature.fastuse.detail:
How to use:
1. On by default - food, ender pearls, potions and similar speed up on their own
2. !fastuse switches it (green = on, red = off)
3. !config FastUseCooldown = 0 changes the cooldown, vanilla is 4, 0 is fastest
Options: FastUse / FastUseCooldown
Note: this only affects using items; block placement speed is !fastplace and is separate
doubletapfly.help.feature.players.title: Player Coordinates
doubletapfly.help.feature.players.summar: list the other players' positions and distances, click to copy
doubletapfly.help.feature.players.detail:
How to use:
1. Run !players and the chat lists the other players, nearest first
2. Each row is name - distance - coordinates, and both are click to copy
3. !config PlayerListRange = 100 only shows players within 100 blocks, 0 = all
4. !config PlayerListSelf = true also lists yourself
Options: PlayerListRange / PlayerListSelf
Limit: only players in your dimension and inside the server's tracking range are known
doubletapfly.help.feature.tp.title: Teleport
doubletapfly.help.feature.tp.summary: move the local player straight to a position
doubletapfly.help.feature.tp.detail:
How to use:
1. !tp              goes to the preset point (HomeX / HomeY / HomeZ)
2. !tp Steve        goes to the player Steve
3. !tp 128 64 -512  goes to those coordinates
4. !config HomeX = 100 changes the preset; !config TeleportWarn = 0 silences the warning
Options: HomeX / HomeY / HomeZ / TeleportWarn
Limit: a vanilla server only accepts about 10 blocks of movement per tick, longer jumps snap back
Fix: have the server run /gamerule player_movement_check false
Note: teleporting into solid blocks is still refused, the target must be in the air
